The weak-ionization leading-order neutral mass fraction of one makes the rounded endpoint estimates approximately, not exactly, reproduce reported Hall conductivity.

Scaling parallel conductivity electrically while holding the Hall-parameter profiles fixed is a phenomenological conditioning step, not a self-consistent collision closure. The absolute-source-conductivity current and gain must be reported separately.

profileCaveats: Core value is an ArII Doppler-width temperature, not a calibrated local neutral temperature.
